steps.sql:
CREATE DATASOURCE aprime_rx DESCRIBE BY "A-prime hospital pharmacy system, MySQL, synthetic" OPTIONS (
  jdbcdriver "com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver", jdbcurl "jdbc:mysql://aprime-mysql:3306/pharmacy", username "aprime", password "<redacted>", fetchsize "1000")
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients FROM aprime_rx.dispense

CREATE DATASOURCE aprime_lab DESCRIBE BY "A-prime EU and US label status, Postgres" OPTIONS (
  jdbcdriver "org.postgresql.Driver", jdbcurl "jdbc:postgresql://aprime-pg:5432/labels", username "aprime", password "<redacted>", fetchsize "1000")
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM aprime_lab.prac_signal

SELECT ps.substance, count(DISTINCT d.patient_id) AS patients
FROM aprime_rx.dispense d JOIN aprime_lab.prac_substance ps ON d.inn = ps.substance GROUP BY ps.substance ORDER BY patients DESC
CREATE LIGHTNING DATABASE aprime_files DESCRIBE BY "A-prime object-store files"

CREATE LIGHTNING FILESTORE TABLE aems FROM aprime_files FORMAT CSV OPTIONS (
  path "s3a://aprime/aems/aems.csv",
  awsAccessKeyId "<redacted>",
  awsSecretAccessKey "<redacted>",
  s3Endpoint "http://aprime-s3:8333",
  header "true",
  delimiter ","
)
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM aprime_files.aems

steps.step: A1 federated join MySQL x Postgres x object store
steps.sql:
SELECT s.row_id, s.signal, ps.substance, u.us_status, u.label_name,
       count(DISTINCT d.patient_id) AS patients_on_drug,
       count(DISTINCT a.row_text) AS fda_aems_rows_naming_drug
FROM aprime_rx.dispense d
JOIN aprime_lab.prac_substance ps ON d.inn = ps.substance
JOIN aprime_lab.prac_signal s ON s.row_id = ps.row_id
JOIN aprime_lab.us_label u ON u.row_id = s.row_id
LEFT JOIN aprime_files.aems a ON lower(a.products) LIKE concat('%', ps.substance, '%')
WHERE u.us_status IN ('not found', 'partial') AND u.auto_checked = false
GROUP BY s.row_id, s.signal, ps.substance, u.us_status, u.label_name
ORDER BY patients_on_drug DESC
